title: Jenkins eggPlant Cleartext Storage of Credentials Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Jenkins eggPlant. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the eggPlant plugin. The issue results from storing credentials in plaintext. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the build process.
